slides.title: Hybi's 5-minute post-game routine
slides.sub: Do it right after the final whistle!

sections.heading: 1. Cool down
lines: ① Walk easy for 5 minutes to settle your breath.
② Calf stretch: 30 sec × 2, each side.
③ Big shoulder circles: 10 forwards, 10 back.
④ Drink water and get a good sleep.

sections.heading: 2. Stop if…
lines: get it assessed before booking a massage.

caption:
Jump, land, spike, repeat. After three volleyball games every weekend, Toto's calves and shoulders feel heavy by Monday.

Remedial massage can help tight muscles feel easier and support recovery. It complements training rather than replacing it, so strength and landing work still matter.

Hybi's post-game routine: walk easy for 5 minutes, calf stretch 30 seconds × 2 each side, then big shoulder circles, 10 each way. Sharp pain or swelling? Get it assessed first.

An ankle that swells after a roll, front-of-knee pain on jumps, or shoulder pain when spiking is worth checking. Our remedial massage therapists at Hybrid Physio can help with recovery. Book online via the link in bio 🏐

General information only — not a substitute for an individual assessment.
